title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 14, 2026, relative to the 2026 Port Security Grant
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 14, 2026, relative to the 2026 Port Security Grant
  Program, as set forth.  [BPC #26-315]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and TRANSMIT to the Mayor and City Council.

Board of Police Commissioners – Agenda  Page 2  October 20, 2026
summary: The Board is asked to approve and forward to the Mayor and City Council a Police Department report on the 2026 Port Security Grant Program.
